metricDefinitions.label: Sharpe annualization comparison
metricDefinitions.definition: On the same complete UTC daily-return series including weekends, Sharpe252=Sharpe365*sqrt(252/365). These display aliases use full-precision saved or retained-scope aggregate Sharpe values; approximation flags are false. Scaling does not change the underlying strategy, daily observations, t-statistics, alpha, CAGR or selections.
